cases.name: modular-sap-architecture
questions: What is the exact business rule or field value used to determine if a cost center is payroll-relevant?
What are the specific OData entity set and properties used for cost center lookup in S4HANA?
What is the exact SOAP action or operation name for the ECP IDoc target system?
What is the exact OData entity set and key structure for upserting employee central costs in SuccessFactors?
Should the original SOAP IDoc XML be preserved as a property or attached as a payload throughout the flow?
blockers: Compiler required: odata_receiver — Call OData V2 service to look up cost center details using extracted cost center ID.
Compiler required: process_direct — Route payroll-relevant cost center records via ProcessDirect to ECP IDoc flow.
Compiler required: process_direct — Route non-payroll-relevant cost center records (employee central costs) via ProcessDirect to SuccessFactors OData upsert flow.
Connected multi-iFlow compilation is not implemented. This is an architecture proposal only.
ReceiveS4HANAIDoc: the https → process_direct adapter path needs an additional compiler.
ReceiveS4HANAIDoc: configuration needed — OData V2 receiver adapter address for cost center lookup
ReceiveS4HANAIDoc: configuration needed — OData V2 receiver adapter authentication method and credentials
ReceiveS4HANAIDoc: configuration needed — ProcessDirect target endpoint for ECP IDoc flow
ReceiveS4HANAIDoc: configuration needed — ProcessDirect target endpoint for SuccessFactors OData upsert flow
ECPIDocFlow: the process_direct → soap adapter path needs an additional compiler.
ECPIDocFlow: configuration needed — SOAP receiver adapter address for ECP IDoc target
ECPIDocFlow: configuration needed — SOAP receiver adapter authentication method and credentials
ECPIDocFlow: configuration needed — SOAP receiver adapter WSDL URL, service name, endpoint, and operation name
SuccessFactorsUpsertFlow: the process_direct → odata adapter path needs an additional compiler.
SuccessFactorsUpsertFlow: configuration needed — OData V2 receiver adapter address for SuccessFactors upsert
SuccessFactorsUpsertFlow: configuration needed — OData V2 receiver adapter authentication method and credentials
SuccessFactorsUpsertFlow: configuration needed — OData V2 receiver adapter entity set and operation details (e.g., POST for upsert)
